s1.syndrome_frame: Chronic gastrointestinal symptoms with malabsorption and dermatological manifestations
salient_findings: Brownish macules on the hands and feet
Hyperchromic punctate lesions on the trunk
key_facts: Multiple type II and III Yamada polyps on atrophic gastric mucosa
Nodular lymphoid lesions in the duodenum
Numerous sessile and subpedunculated polyps throughout the colon and rectum
History of cleft lip and palate repair

raw.syndrome_frame: Chronic gastrointestinal symptoms with malabsorption and dermatological manifestations
salient_findings: Brownish macules on the hands and feet
Hyperchromic punctate lesions on the trunk
key_facts: Multiple type II and III Yamada polyps on atrophic gastric mucosa
Nodular lymphoid lesions in the duodenum
Numerous sessile and subpedunculated polyps throughout the colon and rectum
History of cleft lip and palate repair

differentials: Familial Mediterranean fever with gastrointestinal involvement
Hyper IgE syndrome with gastrointestinal involvement
per_call: Familial Mediterranean fever with gastrointestinal involvement
Hyper IgE syndrome with gastrointestinal involvement

shortlist.label: Crohn's disease
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic gastrointestinal symptoms with malabsorption, weight loss, and extraintestinal manifestations such as skin lesions

shortlist.label: Celiac disease
shortlist.why_kept: Mild hypoproteinemia and hypoalbuminemia, zinc deficiency, and low vitamin B12 levels, consistent with malabsorption

shortlist.label: Juvenile polyposis syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Numerous sessile and subpedunculated polyps throughout the colon and rectum, consistent with a polyposis syndrome

shortlist.label: Autoimmune enteropathy
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic diarrhea, weight loss, and malabsorption, with a history of recurrent diarrheal episodes since childhood

shortlist.label: Abetalipoproteinemia
shortlist.why_kept: Mild hypoproteinemia and hypoalbuminemia, zinc deficiency, and low vitamin B12 levels, consistent with fat malabsorption

raw.rationale: The presence of multiple type II and III Yamada polyps on atrophic gastric mucosa and numerous sessile and subpedunculated polyps throughout the colon and rectum strongly supports this diagnosis, as these are characteristic findings in juvenile polyposis syndrome.

rejected.label: Crohn's disease
rejected.why: While Crohn's disease can cause similar gastrointestinal symptoms, the specific finding of multiple polyps is more characteristic of juvenile polyposis syndrome.

rejected.label: Celiac disease
rejected.why: Celiac disease typically presents with malabsorption and gastrointestinal symptoms, but the presence of multiple polyps is not a characteristic feature.

rejected.label: Autoimmune enteropathy
rejected.why: Autoimmune enteropathy can cause chronic diarrhea and malabsorption, but the presence of multiple polyps is not a typical finding.

rejected.label: Abetalipoproteinemia
rejected.why: Abetalipoproteinemia is a rare disorder characterized by malabsorption of fat-soluble vitamins, but the presence of multiple polyps is not a characteristic feature.
